title: gagea pygmaea subsp. nevadensis
intro: Gagea pygmaea subsp. nevadensis, commonly known as the Nevada gagea, is a plant species within the lily family (Liliaceae) and is endemic to the southwestern United States, specifically in Nevada. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from respiratory issues, such as coughs and colds. The therapeutic actions of Gagea pygmaea subsp. nevadensis include expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties, which help to ease congestion and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
